title: A flat colimit of finite modules over Noetherian local stages is flat at some stage
statement: Let $(\Lambda,\le)$ be a nonempty directed set. Suppose given, for every $\lambda\in\Lambda$, Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] $(A_\lambda,\mathfrak m_\lambda)$ and $B_\lambda$, a local homomorphism $A_\lambda\to B_\lambda$ (it maps $\mathfrak m_\lambda$ into the maximal ideal of $B_\lambda$) and a finitely generated $B_\lambda$-module $N_\lambda$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]; and, for $\lambda\le\mu$, local homomorphisms $A_\lambda\to A_\mu$ and $B_\lambda\to B_\mu$ commuting with $A_\lambda\to B_\lambda$ and $A_\mu\to B_\mu$, and an additive map $N_\lambda\to N_\mu$, $x\mapsto\bar x$, with $\overline{bx}=\bar b\,\bar x$ for $b\in B_\lambda$; all transition maps equal to the identity for $\lambda=\mu$ and compatible with composition. Let $A$ and $B$ be the colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of the rings $A_\lambda$ and $B_\lambda$ in the category of commutative rings, with the induced ring map $A\to B$, and let $N$ be the colimit of the abelian groups $N_\lambda$, a $B$-module by $\bar b\,\bar x=\overline{bx}$ (and an $A$-module through $A\to B$). Assume that for all $\lambda\le\mu$: (a) the ring map $B_\lambda\otimes_{A_\lambda}A_\mu\to B_\mu$, $b\otimes a\mapsto\bar b\,\bar a$, is a localization of $B_\lambda\otimes_{A_\lambda}A_\mu$ at some multiplicative subset (a ring map $C\to D$ is a *localization of $C$ at* a multiplicative subset $W\subseteq C$ if every element of $W$ maps to a unit of $D$, every element of $D$ is the image of $c$ times the inverse of the image of $w$ for some $c\in C$, $w\in W$, and $c\mapsto0$ implies $wc=0$ for some $w\in W$); (b) the map $N_\lambda\otimes_{B_\lambda}B_\mu\to N_\mu$, $x\otimes b\mapsto b\,\bar x$, is an isomorphism. If $N$ is a flat $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then there is $\lambda\in\Lambda$ such that $N_\lambda$ is a flat $A_\lambda$-module.

proof.text: Install the four algebra structures from φ_i, α_f, β_f, φ_j and the composite β_f φ_i. The commuting square gives both scalar towers. A_i/I is a field, so (A_i/I) tensor N_i is flat by [lem-weil-pbc-module-over-field-flat]. Restrict e : B_j tensor_(B_i) N_i ≃ N_j to A_j scalars. Tensor its inverse with I A_j to obtain E and set θ=E τ. Evaluating e at 1 tensor x proves e⁻¹(η_f x)=1 tensor x. Thus θ has the pure-tensor formula required by the local criterion. Since τ kills the multiplication kernel, so does θ.

This gives flatness of B_j tensor_(B_i) N_i over A_j. Transport it along the A_j-linear restriction of e using Module.Flat.equiv_iff, obtaining flatness of N_j [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and return j.

split_report.summary: Read 00R6 (line 32723) and its proof, the system of 00QX (line 32427), 00MO (line 23921) with its proof, 00ML (line 23751) and Remark 00M6 (line 18690); tags checked in tags/tags. The statement (adapted hypotheses: Noetherian local stages, 'a localization') is kept: it is what the proof of 00R6 and 00MO need, and it is what the only citer lem-weil-pbc-criterion-flatness-fibre uses in its steps 5 and 7 (systems R_lambda -> S'_lambda, M_lambda and S^_lambda -> S'^_lambda, M^_lambda). Proof in 7 steps following the source: restriction to the indices >= lambda (colimit-initial-full-subcategory); Ker(m (x) N_lambda -> N_lambda) finitely generated over B_lambda (noetherian-submodule-finite), generators xi_i; A and N are the colimits of the A_mu, N_mu as A_lambda-modules (modules-criterion with algebras-elementwise, rings-zero, modules-elementwise) and m (x)_{A_lambda} - commutes with these colimits (tensor-commutes-with-colimits, 00DD); flatness of N over A (flat-tensor-exact applied to 0 -> K -> m (x)_{A_lambda} A -> A) writes the image of each xi_i in m (x)_{A_lambda} N as a sum of elements k*z with k in K; these descend to a stage lambda' (modules-elementwise, rings-zero), where the xi_i die in m A_lambda' (x) N_lambda', and B_lambda-semilinearity kills the whole kernel; the new node lem-weil-pbc-flat-another-variant-local-criterion (00MO, stated with the Tor_1 hypothesis in kernel form via 00M6, as the existing 00ML node is) with module-over-field-flat gives flatness of N_lambda'. The source's 'Ker(m_lambda R (x)_R M -> M) = 0' and 'tensor commutes with colimits' over the varying rings R_lambda' are carried out over the fixed ring A_lambda, so that the proof stays in the route of sk-thm-p1 (the varying-ring node lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-tensor-varying-rings is of unit sk-thm-reduction). Remark 00M6 is used only inside the new node's statement: the item's proof works with the kernels directly. Not a Mathlib leaf: the searches recorded on the node (LeanSearch, LeanFinder, Loogle, grep, local_search) plus a new LeanSearch find no descent of flatness to a stage of a colimit.
